announcements.text: Fluor Marine Propulsion LLC, Arlington, Virginia, was awarded a $2,409,077,590 cost-plus-fixed-fee modification to a previously awarded contract (N0002418C2130) for Naval Nuclear Propulsion work at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory. Work will be performed in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania (47%); Schenectady, New York (45%); and Idaho Falls, Idaho (8%). Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $582,062 (97%); and fiscal 2026 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds in the amount of $15,838 (3%), was obligated at time of award, of which funds in the amount of $15,838 expired at the end of the fiscal 2026. The Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity. (Awarded Sept. 24, 2026).

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Co., Fort Worth, Texas, is awarded a $114,629,966 cost-plus-fixed-fee order (N0001927F1037) against a previously issued basic ordering agreement (N0001924G0010). This order provides nonrecurring engineering, redesign, integration, qualification, and testing for two F-35 Lightning II navigation systems: the Global Positioning System Electronic Unit and the NAV100 Inertial Navigation System. The effort will replace obsolete electronic components while maintaining system performance and compatibility with existing aircraft systems. These redesigns are intended to prevent production disruptions, address diminishing manufacturing sources, and support the continued production and sustainment of F-35 aircraft for the Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, and F-35 cooperative program partners. Work will be performed in El Segundo, California (70.1%); Fort Worth, Texas (27.5%); and Clearwater, Florida (2.4%), and is expected to be completed in January 2030. Fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Air Force) funds in the amount of $46,411,323; fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $46,411,322; and F-35 cooperative program partner funds in the amount of $21,807,321, will be obligated at the time of award. This order was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Huntington Ingalls Inc., Newport News Shipbuilding, Newport News, Virginia (N6660420DD002); Oceaneering International Inc., Chesapeake, Virginia (N6660420DD003); Epsilon Systems Solution Inc., San Diego, California (N6660424DD004); and Delphinus Engineering Inc.,* Eddystone, Pennsylvania (N6660424DD005), are awarded a shared $98,078,464 dollar ceiling increase modification to a previously awarded Submarine Safety (SUBSAFE) multiple-award contract for the continuation of SUBSAFE/Level 1 hardware fabrication and associated technical and engineering services. Work will be performed at the contractors’ sites and minimally at government locations and is expected to be completed by November 2029. Funding will be obligated at delivery and task order level as contract actions occur. Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division Newport, Newport, Rhode Island, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Northrup Grumman Systems Corp., Magna, Utah, is awarded a $43,856,500 firm-fixed-price contract (N0003027C2002) to support the design of new rocket motor dry and grind production facilities and equipment which will be located at the Naval Industrial Reserve Ordnance Plant (NIROP) in Magna, Utah. This effort supports the TRIDENT II (D5) Strategic Weapon System and work will be performed in Magna, Utah. Work is expected to be completed on Aug. 31, 2028. Fiscal 2026 weapons procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $43,856,500 will be obligated on this award and no funds will expire at the end of this fiscal year. This contract was awarded as a sole source acquisition pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 2304(c)(1). PAE Strategic Systems Programs, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Vigor Marine LLC, Portland, Oregon, is awarded a $42,758,897 firm-fixed-price contract (N3220527C0002) for a 120-calendar day shipyard availability for the regular overhaul and drydocking availability of Military Sealift Command’s replenishment oiler USNS Henry J. Kaiser (T-AO 187). This contract includes a base work package and four unexercised options for additional work and time, which if exercised, would increase the cumulative value of this contract to $45,820,041. Work will be performed in Portland, Oregon, beginning Dec. 15, 2026, and is expected to be completed by April 13, 2027. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $42,758,8967 are obligated and will expire at the end of the fiscal year. This contract was competitively solicited via the Governmentwide Point of Entry website and one offer was received. Military Sealift Command, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Mountain Point LLC, San Antonio, Texas, was awarded a $12,446,048 firm-fixed-price contract for the full facility modification of a fuel cell hangar to accommodate the C-130J aircraft. National Guard Bureau, Directorate of Acquisitions, Operational Contracting Division, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity (W50S76-27-C-A001).
